proof_body:
by
  intro X _ _ F hc hne hd hs
  have hanti : Antitone F := antitone_nat_of_succ_le hd
  choose p hp using hne
  have hC : CauchySeq p := by
    rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hs ε hε
    exact ⟨N, fun m hm n hn => hN _ (hanti hm (hp m)) _ (hanti hn (hp n))⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hC
  have hmem : ∀ n, x ∈ F n := fun n =>
    (hc n).mem_of_tendsto hx (Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨n, fun m hm => hanti hm (hp m)⟩)
  refine ⟨x, hmem, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  by_contra hne'
  have hpos : 0 < dist y x := dist_pos.2 hne'
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hs (dist y x) hpos
  exact lt_irrefl _ (hN y (hy N) x (hmem N))
target_source: ∀ (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] [CompleteSpace X] (F : ℕ → Set X), (∀ n, IsClosed (F n)) → (∀ n, (F n).Nonempty) → (∀ n, F (n + 1) ⊆ F n) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ F N, ∀ y ∈ F N, dist x y < ε) → ∃! x : X, ∀ n, x ∈ F n
